messages:
alyssa: Quick question—need to assemble audit evidence for KMS usage across AWS/GCP/Azure for SOC2 packet. Looking for minimal set of CloudTrail/GCP AuditLog/Azure diag queries + where to pull key rotation metadata. Anyone done end-to-end?

ben: I put together a checklist last quarter. Will share snippets.

ben: AWS CloudTrail (CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
| filter eventSource = 'kms.amazonaws.com'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
Look for CreateKey, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, ReEncrypt, GenerateDataKey

sara: For SOC2 we need: key creation, rotation events, grants/iam policy changes, decrypt/encrypt api calls, and CMK material usage mapping to resources. Also proof of who approved key creation.

james: GCP audit logs filter:
```
resource.type="cloudkms_key_ring"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.Key.*"
```
Also export admin activity vs data access.

ben: Azure CLI to list diagnostics and key rotation:
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
az keyvault key show --vault-name <vault> --name <key> --query 'attributes'
```
Rotation events surface in Activity Logs as "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/write" with operationName.

alyssa: Where do we get envelope encryption evidence? We need to show that data keys are generated and wrapped; i.e., GenerateDataKey/Encrypt usage.

james: Search for GenerateDataKey / GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext in AWS; in GCP Check CryptoKeyVersion used in Encrypt calls; Azure: wrapKey/unwrapKey ops.

sara: Also need retention windows. SOC2 expects logs retained X days. We must include S3/GCS/Blob retention settings and where exported.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new artifact uploaded: kms-evidence-template.xlsx (link) :file_folder:

ben: I'll drop a minimal evidence mapping table later today. Also note: CloudTrail can be bucketed to S3 with event selectors including ReadWrite type for KMS. For GCP, you want to sink audit logs to a logging bucket and export as well.

alyssa: :thumbsup: Can you add sample queries and a short how-to for pulling rotation state? We'd like to hand-off to Compliance.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: FYI retention policy change scheduled for logging-bucket PROD on Friday

sara: If we need attestations: include change control ticket IDs and PRs that created key access roles. I'll collect approvals.

james: Edge case: encrypted blobs created by third-party services—need mapping of service account usage. Quick grep in CloudTrail for assumed-role ARNs.

ben: One more snippet - CloudTrail S3 event selector JSON:
```
{
  "ReadWriteType": "All",
  "IncludeManagementEvents": true,
  "DataResources": [
    {
      "Type": "AWS::S3::Object",
      "Values": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

alyssa: Great. I'll assemble into a single folder and share defs. If anyone has existing exported bundles (zip of logs + manifest) ping me.

sara: :eyes: I'll add compliance checklist and checklist of required evidence fields.
